system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
y←M(Q, A) // generate next action based on the
instructionQand current responseA
system_prompt_style.note: The prompt is the instruction plus the list of data files; no system prompt builder appears in the evidence. Inferred from the README prompt format ('# Instruction ... # Data File 1: ...').

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: it passively accepts structured data expressed as text in the input, while also actively inspecting external data sources according to user inputs, where the filenames of the external data sources are specified in inputs
env_context_strategy.note: File names and sizes are injected up front (closest value: file_tree_summary), and the model then explores via code.

context_compaction.note: The figures show '(more results are omitted to save space)', but these are editorial omissions in the paper, not a harness mechanism.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
once a ⟨Code⟩··· ⟨/Code⟩ is generated, DeepAnalyze exe-
cutes the code in the environment and places the feedback
in ⟨Execute⟩··· ⟨/Execute⟩
tool_call_format.note: Special-token tags wrap Python code that is executed as the action.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
⟨Code⟩··· ⟨/Code⟩ : Generate code to interact with the data
in the environment, using Python suited for data science.
tool_count.note: The only executable action is Python code. The other tags (Analyze, Understand, Answer) are text actions, not tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
⟨Code⟩··· ⟨/Code⟩ : Generate code to interact with the data
in the environment, using Python suited for data science.
edit_primitive.note: There is no file-edit tool; files are written via Python code. Value given as a string by mistake is avoided: see list form below.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
In practice, we extend the vocabulary of the foundation
LLM to support the generation of these special tokens.
tool_schema_source.note: The action tags are fixed special tokens learned in training; there is no schema. Closest value.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: DeepAnalyze is now accessible through the JupyterUI, building based on [jupyter-mcp-server](https://github.com/datalayer/jupyter-mcp-server).
protocol_standardization.note: MCP is used only in the JupyterUI demo; the core inference does not use it.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
⟨Analyze⟩··· ⟨/Analyze⟩ : Analyze textually, including plan-
ning, reasoning, reflection, self-verification

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: It can autonomously complete a wide range of data-centric tasks without human intervention

self_verification.evidence_quote:
all actions (i.e.,
special tokens) are autonomously generated by the model
without any human-defined workflows or rules
self_verification.note: Self-verification happens only inside Analyze text. The LLM-judge rewards apply to training only.

termination_condition.note: Other caps are not visible in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Added support for a Docker-based sandbox code execution environment.
execution_isolation.note: By default, code runs locally in the workspace. The Docker sandbox is an option in WebUI v2.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We have unified the evaluation of most existing data science benchmarks using vLLM (with more being continuously added...). You can directly follow the introduction in [./playground](./playground)

target_domain.evidence_quote: DeepAnalyze is the first agentic LLM for autonomous data science.

open_source.evidence_quote: The [model](https://huggingface.co/RUC-DataLab/DeepAnalyze-8B), [code](https://github.com/ruc-datalab/DeepAnalyze), [training data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/RUC-DataLab/DataScience-Instruct-500K), and [demo](https://huggingface.co/RUC-DataLab/DeepAnalyze-8B) of DeepAnalyze are all open-sourced
open_source.note: The LICENSE file exists but its content is not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Clone this repository to deploy DeepAnalyze locally as your data analyst, completing any data science tasks without any workflow or closed-source APIs.
model_agnostic.note: The harness is tied to the DeepAnalyze-8B special tokens and served via vLLM with an OpenAI-style API.

primary_artifact.note: The paper is arXiv 2510.16872; the repo has evolved since (WebUI v2, API).

first_release_date.note: Based on the README release announcement; no tags are visible in the evidence.

pinned_version.note: No tag is given in the evidence; the main commit is used instead.
